note: LG.3b. At HEAD the raw-SQL scan runs over the WHOLE file once any SQL signature appears (Go's `select {` statement counts), so prose and comments mint tables; CTE names, LATERAL / SET and function calls (COALESCE after EXTRACT's FROM, jsonb_array_elements) are captured as tables; a Go fmt message `delete from spaces key=%q: %w` reads as SQL; Go mongo-driver .Collection("events") (capital C) is never matched. The statements are package consts on purpose: the Go parser's own per-call-argument SQL scan (parsers/code/go) is a separate scanner, not this fixture's subject.
